rules.statement: Don't skip, disable or weaken a test (loosened assertions, removed cases, added skip attributes) to get a change's checks to pass.
rules.why: A weakened test is a shortcut that hides a behavior the change was supposed to deliver, even when the checks pass.
rules.check: Look in the diff for removed or loosened assertions, deleted test cases, new Skip/Ignore attributes, or expected values changed to match new output with no reason given.

rules.statement: Don't swallow exceptions or errors: a catch block must handle, translate or rethrow the error, not silently discard it.
rules.why: Swallowed errors are a shortcut that hides failures the change should surface.
rules.check: Look for empty catch blocks, catch-all handlers that only return a default, or ignored error results added in the diff.

rules.statement: Don't hard-code values in place of the real computation or configuration, and don't leave TODO comments for unfinished work in a change.
rules.why: Hard-coded values and leftover TODOs are shortcuts that mean the work wasn't done as specified.
rules.check: Look for new literal values standing in for computed or configured ones, and for new TODO/FIXME/HACK comments in the diff.

rules.statement: In a pre-release project, describe the product as it is: add no compatibility shims, migration notes, `**Breaking:**` labels, or wording set against an earlier state, in code, docs or the changelog.
rules.why: ADR-0015: a pre-release product has no released earlier state to stay compatible with or migrate from.
rules.check: In a pre-release project, look for obsolete forwarding members, compatibility overloads, 'previously'/'now'/'no longer' wording, migration sections, or Breaking labels in docs and changelog entries.

rules.statement: In a pre-release project, keep the changelog's `## [Unreleased]` section a catalog under only `### Added` and `### Security` headings.
rules.why: ADR-0015: before release there is nothing to be Changed, Deprecated, Removed or Fixed relative to; the changelog catalogs the product as it is.
rules.check: In a pre-release project's CHANGELOG.md, look for `### Changed`, `### Removed`, `### Fixed`, `### Deprecated` or other headings under `## [Unreleased]`.
